0022600167.text: The Rockets (6-1, 3-0 at home, 6-1 in their last ten) host the Celtics (5-1, 4-0 at home, on a five-game winning streak) in Houston's eighth game of the season, with Houston 2nd in the Southwest and Boston 2nd in the Atlantic, each half a game back of the division lead. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on February 4, 2026 in Houston, when the Rockets lost 114-93. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest).
